wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A is an EMPTY SCHEDULE: the filer drew a dash in the Date cell of the first writing line and wrote 'NONE' across the Name of Contributor column; no amount is written anywhere on the sheet. Zero rows emitted (a real zero, not a gap). All six line-1/line-2 cover cells carry a SLASHED-ZERO glyph, which per the repo zero-glyph ruling is 0 - so a zero schedule agrees with a zero cover on both the over-$50 line and the separate $50-or-less aggregate line. Carr Form A prints no schedule total.

expenditures.detail: One Form B row, 488.55, equals BOTH the cover's line-3 THIS REPORT cell and its CUMULATIVE cell (488.55); the LAST cell is a slashed zero, so THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide - this is the first report of the cycle. Carr Form B prints no schedule total.

gates.page_subtotal: Form prints no schedule total or page subtotal on either sheet. p2: empty schedule, nothing to sum, cover line-1 cells all zero-glyphs. p3: rows sum 488.55 = cover line-3 THIS 488.55 = CUM 488.55 - closes exactly.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py returns geometry_status 'gaps' on BOTH p2 and p3 of this document - the scan is faint and speckled and the tool loses the top rules (p3's first reported rule is at 24.91%, well below the header). Its output is therefore NOT usable as the row-count oracle here and ink rows were counted by eye at 200 dpi and re-checked in 600 dpi crops: p2 carries ink on exactly one writing line ('NONE' + a dash, no amount) = 0 transactions; p3 carries ink on exactly one writing line = 1 row emitted. The rest of both sheets is scan speckle and bleed-through, not writing.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 600 dpi crop of the row-1 amount cell (x4200,y700,W800,H280) renders the 'Amount' header, its double rule, and '488.55'; the control crop one row-pitch below (y980,H240) renders EMPTY (two printed rules, no ink), which also measured the pitch at ~2.3% of page height. p2 600 dpi full-width crop of the first writing line renders '- | NONE' and an empty amount cell.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 reads LAST 0 (slashed zero) / THIS 488.55 / CUM 488.55. The chain does NOT close as a cash balance: 0 + contributions 0 - expenditures 488.55 = -488.55, not +488.55. The filer has copied line 3 into line 4 (both rows read 0 / 488.55 / 488.55). Retained verbatim; nothing recomputed. Cross-filing: the same filer's later 11/18/2020 report (key 9e31cc88) does NOT chain on line 3 - see that record's balance_chain.

escalation_note: 600 dpi tight crops: p3 row-1 amount cell, p3 one-pitch control, p2 first writing line full width; plus a 400 dpi crop of cover lines 1-2 and another of cover lines 3-4 to read the slashed-zero glyphs and the money cells.

CRAIG McALLISTER' and 'Name of Office' reads 'CACHE COUNTY TREASURER' with 'Office District: CACHE COUNTY' - agrees (county office, in scope).
